decisions.reason: Selecting the Seattle page as the future-location template does not change the existing requirement for dedicated, consistently branded location pages.
The template-basis decision does not alter the existing architecture requiring separate Wix sites and accounts for operational locations.
Using Seattle as a page template does not change location-selector options or routing destinations.
The future-location template basis does not change the master site's national branding, information, or booking role.
The Seattle booking status and opening activation behavior already have a same-message Event; choosing the Seattle page as the future template adds no necessary booking-state change.
The template-basis decision concerns page reuse and does not modify the existing independent business-data requirements.
The requirement already specifies consistent SMASH ROOM branding across locations, and selecting Seattle as a template does not change that branding state.
The Seattle page's coming-soon mode, layout, and opening transition are unchanged; its new role as the future-location template is independently represented by the source Requirement.
Using the Seattle page for future-location reuse does not replace or modify the existing visual references, style, or cross-location design-consistency requirement.
The page-template decision does not change the existing separate payment and payout handling for locations.
The Seattle VIP signup and its button label remain unchanged; template reuse does not necessarily modify this atomic signup requirement.
The Seattle page becoming a template for future location pages does not alter the separately defined master-homepage sections.
